prompt:
Create a production pixel game sprite animation sheet with18 isolated FULL BODY poses, exactly6columns by3rows. Request square1536x1536; genuinely transparent RGBA background. No text/labels/grid/floor/shadow/scene/aura/particles/glow.

IMAGE1 is Wang Lin Pixel02 extracted from the CURRENT GAME, facing EAST. This is PRIMARY anatomy, pixel treatment and CAMERA reference. Match its large chibi skull/head about half standing height, compact torso, short legs, broad low-resolution pixel clusters and palette density. Change identity to the NPC described below; never copy Wang long hair/clothes.

IMAGE2 is the OWNER-APPROVED neutral identity of this SAME NPC in southeast, enlarged nearest8x. Preserve exact face/skull/hair/bun identity and costume/props, but rotate into the real requested view. IMAGE3 is the accepted southeast action sheet for the SAME NPC; use ONLY for action progression and identity continuity. DO NOT copy southeast facing from images2or3.

Identity: Elderly woman cultivation teacher with softly aged face and grey-salt compact bun. Ivory and smoky jade robe, small jade string and closed bamboo scroll. No beard, no young heroine face.

MANDATORY camera for ALL18poses: RIGHT PROFILE facing screen RIGHT. Only right side of face and one eye visible, nose pointing RIGHT. No front-left face. Fixed orthographic isometric game camera exactly as image1. All rows and all action frames keep this camera/view. Never swivel toward southeast/front to make an action legible. Back views gesture seen from BEHIND; visible face detail depends on camera. No mirrored substitute. Clothing asymmetry/held objects remain on anatomical correct side when viewed from opposite directions.

LAYOUT:6columns3rows, generous transparent gaps. All18 standing figures have EXACT SAME physical pixel scale and anatomy. Neutral hair-top to boot-bottom approximately240sourcepixels, bodywidth at most150sourcepixels; do NOT fill rowheight/cellheight. Keep generous top/bottom margins in every row, especially thirdrow. Equal head/skull dimensions and boot spread across rows; only drawn breath/arm/cloth changes. Full hands/boots/props always visible. Feet planted at each pose ground, NO stepping or root translation. Never shrink a gesture row to fit the canvas.

ROW1 IDLE6:1 neutral calibration standing;2 slight inhalation;3 small shoulders/sleeves breath;4 calm exhalation;5 soft blink if eyes visible (back view no drawn eyes);6 EXACT SAME neutral as1. No whole-body bob/resize, no widening skull.

ROW2 TALK6:1 exact neutral;2 slight mouth movement only if mouth visible and raising forearm;3 small calm explanatory palm in facing direction;4 hold gesture and natural second mouth shape if visible;5 retract forearm;6 exact neutral. Direction remains EAST. Props attached to same hand/waist; no disappearing or changing sword hand.

ROW3 PROFESSION6: A calm breath-teaching gesture: neutral, draws palms near abdomen, gently separates palms, holds inward palms, closes hands, exact neutral. Jade string remains attached. No visible qi or FX in body sheet. Maintain requested EAST view throughout. Gesture seen from this camera; never turn torso/face to southeast. Only arms/wrist/cloth change; all skull/torso/legs/boots retain same size as row1. Frame1and6 exact neutral matching row1frame1.

Original NPC same game as Wang live. Crisp integer-style pixel clusters, no smooth detailed illustration to shrink. Human native nominal80worldpixels standing height; base64x96 foot32,88. Clip96x96 foot48,88 adds padding ONLY. Keep body, hand-held prop together for pilot; no FX/shadow. These are real18 motion poses, not one repeated static picture. New directions are review candidates; approval of southeast must not be claimed for them.
